gen-gf-warnes-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Clipped capitals and ascenders give the body text a crisp stride beside Warnes, whose stretched, spacious letters taper out before touching. Atkinson Hyperlegible keeps its wide-set s terminals easy to follow line after line, never tiring the eye.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-m: Chunky and stretched, Warnes announces itself with crossbars as fat as the stems. And Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono does the quiet work, its open counters breathing into wide, stencil-like spacing.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-n: Warnes tapers its ink strokes out before they ever touch, giving every letter a stretched, spacious feel. And Atkinson Hyperlegible Next steps in with big-eyed lowercase and rounds left unsealed, so the two share an open feel.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-biryani: Loud and loose-limbed, Warnes stretches its tapering ink strokes out while Biryani keeps every e wide-eyed and every counter unclogged. Big gestures up top, tidy detail down in the text.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-blinker: Approachable is the word for the text, its lowercase filling most of the height beneath bold, stretched Warnes. Blinker keeps apertures open and strokes steady, so pages move easily.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-carrois-gothic: Warnes has a pen-plotter smoothness, with ink strokes that taper out before touching, spaced wide. Carrois Gothic handles the text, its high-set x-height and generous c opening doing the work.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-chivo: Chivo reads approachable, its lowercase packed up toward the capitals and daylight showing through every curve. Warnes earns its keep big and brief, every ink stroke the same width.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-comme: Comme reads smooth, with no clogged curves anywhere on the line. Warnes above it brings stretched, spacious letters in ballpoint-pen strokes, while Comme's lowercase bodies fill most of the letter height.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-cossette-texte: Loud letters up top, friendly text below. What stands out is the gap between Warnes, stretched and tapering, and Cossette Texte, whose wide-eyed e and prominent x-height stay inviting.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-funnel-sans: Clean describes Funnel Sans, strokes holding steady from stem to curve. Warnes is loud and stretched, while Funnel Sans stays tidy with an e opened wide, and that gap is the whole appeal.
